$comment: INFRA-040 — the raw-control ratchet. This file is the WHOLE definition of the check: what is banned, where it is banned, who is permanently exempt, and who is grandfathered. `eslint.config.js` reads it and builds `no-restricted-syntax` blocks from it, so the rule and its baseline can never disagree. It rides the gates that already exist — `npx eslint $staged_ts` in .githooks/pre-commit and `npm run lint` in CI — and adds no hook step and no CI step (sprint-026 P6). `baseline` is a RATCHET: an entry may shrink or disappear, never appear. The closed census it may not exceed is pinned in scripts/raw-controls-ratchet.test.ts. Migrating a file means DELETING its entry here — the test fails on an entry whose file no longer carries a raw control, and once the entry is gone the file is locked out and can never take one back. The `role-dialog` ban (UI-193 criterion 2, landed via PR #77 finding 3) is the overlay half: a hand-written role="dialog" outside kit's Controls is refused, so a new overlay is built on kit Modal/Popover or it does not lint. HONESTY, per sprint-026 seam 2: this catches the ROLE as syntax, in the files it lints, and nothing more — a fixed-position overlay that omits the role is invisible to this rule, and that class belongs to the overlay battery's completeness scan (which also matches kit Modal/Popover imports) and to review. Claiming otherwise here would be the check lying about its coverage.

banned.message: A raw <button> is not the product's button. Use Button, IconButton or Chip from @corpus/kit — one shape, one focus ring, one set of tokens (INFRA-040). The grandfathered files are listed in scripts/raw-controls-baseline.json, and that list may only shrink.
A raw <select> renders native chrome the product does not use. Use Select from @corpus/kit — the pill trigger with the custom menu (INFRA-040). No file is grandfathered for <select>.
A raw <option> only exists inside a native dropdown. Pass the choices to Select from @corpus/kit as its `items` prop instead (INFRA-040). No file is grandfathered for <option>.

A hand-written role="dialog" overlay carries none of the exit guarantees. Build on Modal or Popover from @corpus/kit — a close affordance, Escape with focus return, a focus trap and outside-press dismissal are unconditional there (UI-193). The grandfathered files are listed in scripts/raw-controls-baseline.json, and that list may only shrink.
